reason: My POS mostly works and switching means retraining my techs and risking a bad week at the counter. I also hear 'cheaper' from every new POS and the card fee is where the money is, so I'd want proof before touching anything.
objection: Card fees are where the real money is. Stripe's 2.7% + 5c sounds like what I already pay, so is it really cheaper? And I'd have to buy a $299 reader and move my whole salon over to a new company nobody I know uses.
would_change_my_mind: My sister-in-law or another owner I know using it for a few months and showing me their real card statement with lower fees, plus them moving my client list over for free.
